description: Look up Czech VR companies connected to a person by exact registry person_id -> roles -> companies joins. Free anonymous tool. Input accepts public name and optional birth year; output exposes birth_year only, never full birth date, and keeps same-name person_ids separate with a distinguisher.

birth_year.description: Optional public birth year used to narrow same-name matches.

name.description: Person full name as recorded in VR, e.g. "Jan Novak".

name: person_companies
